chunks: Al-Husayn b. Ahmad b. Idris (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from Ya'qub b. Yazid from Muhammad b. Abi 'Umayr from Mu'awiya b. Wahb from Abu Sa'id Hashim from Abi 'Abdillah al-Sadiq (peace be upon him). He said:
Four will not enter Paradise: the soothsayer, the hypocrite, the wine addict, and the backbiter (al-qattat) — and he is the gossiper (al-nammam).

key_terms.القتات: The backbiter — a synonym for al-nammam, one who carries tales between people to cause enmity
key_terms.الكاهن: The soothsayer — one who claims knowledge of the unseen or future events through divination
key_terms.المنافق: The hypocrite — one who outwardly professes Islam while concealing disbelief
key_terms.النمام: The gossiper — one who spreads people's private conversations to sow discord
key_terms.مدمن الخمر: The wine addict — one who habitually consumes alcohol

ai.seo_question: What are the four types of people who will not enter Paradise according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) enumerates four types of people who will be barred from Paradise: the soothsayer (who claims knowledge of the unseen), the hypocrite (who outwardly professes faith but conceals disbelief), the habitual drunkard, and the gossiper who spreads tales between people to sow discord. The hadith clarifies that 'al-qattat' and 'al-nammam' are synonymous, both referring to one who carries tales to create enmity.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him

en.bilal-muhammad: Al-Husayn b. Ahmad b. Idris (rh) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from Ya`qub b. Yazid from Muhammad b. Abi `Umayr from Mu`awiya b. Wahb from Abi Sa`id Hashim from Abi `Abdillah al-Sadiq (as). He said:
There are four who will not enter Paradise: (1) The soothsayer, (2) the hypocrite, (3) the wine addict, and (4) backbiter (al-qattat); and he is the gossiper (al-nammam).
